tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Facts about the product: what it does, who it is for, what it does not do, and how an agent can use it. No login. No login needed.

tools.name: get_pricing
tools.description: The free plan and the one-time Early Access pass: price, what each includes, refund window. Payment needs a person in a browser. No login. No login needed.

tools.name: list_faq
tools.description: Every FAQ question and answer from the home page, paged. No login. No login needed.

tools.name: get_sample_report
tools.description: Shows the shape of a real report (visibility numbers, rivals, ranked plan) for a fictional coffee roaster. Made-up data, no login. No login needed.

tools.name: get_account
tools.description: Returns the user's plan (free or early_access), when the pass ends, what the plan allows, and how to upgrade. Needs login with scope account:read.

tools.name: list_reports
tools.description: The user's reports, newest first, paged with a cursor. Each has its stage (analyzing, needs_confirmation, running, finished, failed). Needs login with scope reports:read.

tools.name: create_report
tools.description: Creates a report draft for a website and starts reading it. Free plan: one website, one report every 30 days. Returns 202 Accepted with the report, a job object and a Location header: poll that URL (GET /api/v1/reports/{reportId}) every few seconds until stage is needs_confirmation, then call the st

tools.name: batch_get_reports
tools.description: Batch read: send a list of report ids and get each report (or its error) in one answer, instead of one call per report. Each result has its own status, so one unknown id does not fail the rest. Read-only. Needs login with scope reports:read.

tools.name: get_report
tools.description: While stage is needs_confirmation it returns the business profile and the proposed buyer questions. While running it returns progress. When finished it returns visibility numbers, the brands AI named, and a count of lost questions. Needs login with scope reports:read.

tools.name: start_report
tools.description: Accepts the proposed business profile and buyer questions (optionally a chosen subset of 3 to 6 question ids) and starts asking the AI engines. Takes about two minutes: answers 202 Accepted with a Location header to poll until stage is finished. Safe to repeat; send an Idempotency-Key header to make

tools.name: get_report_actions
tools.description: For a finished report: up to three ranked moves (reason, exact edit, page, effort) and, for each buyer question AI answered with a rival, who won and why. Needs login with scope reports:read.

tools.name: get_agent_readiness
tools.description: Score, grade, layer breakdown and ranked fixes from the newest scan of the report's website. Needs the Early Access pass; otherwise 402 with a link a person can open to buy it. Needs login with scope agent-readiness:read.

tools.name: scan_agent_readiness
tools.description: Runs, or reuses a result under 24 hours old, for the report's website. Set force to true to scan again after fixing something. Rate limited. Needs login with scope agent-readiness:scan.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: create_report · Public sink: create_report, batch_get_reports, start_report.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: create_report · Public sink: create_report, batch_get_reports, start_report

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
